retrieval.rag_summary:
Trade Select Ballistic Point Insulation Fasteners (manufactured by ICCONS under
the GTIF series and distributed alongside Trade Select insulation) are
pre-assembled ballistic drive pins with integrated plastic washer heads designed
for gas-actuated concrete nailers. Engineered to secure rigid insulation boards
(25mm to 100mm) directly to hard concrete, masonry, and steel substrates without
pre-drilling, they accelerate installation on commercial carpark soffits,
basement ceilings, and precast facade walls.
